preregistered_net_rule: Training ends 2024-12-31. Among the 12 challengers (all except pooled_raw), require higher full IS net Sharpe than pooled_raw at identical timing, CAGR >= max(BIL CAGR, matched control CAGR minus 0.5pp), DD <= matched control DD + 2pp, both two-year IS halves profitable, positive full IS CAGR after placing its own three largest training winners in cash, positive 20bp/delay1 IS CAGR. Rank eligible challengers by higher weaker-half net Sharpe, then weaker-half CAGR, then full IS Sharpe, then lower turnover and lexical ID. If none qualifies, retain top-ranked challenger for diagnostics, label failure. Seal before later portfolio evaluation. No OOS rescue.
